title: Marlboro Bolt-Action Handgun
summary: A hard-surface prop that turns Marlboro's vintage visual branding into a fictional bolt-action handgun.
description: This personal study translates the bold geometry, white-and-red palette, and distinctive typeface of Marlboro into a fictional weapon. The project showcases my hard-surface modeling and Substance 3D Painter skills.
coverAlt: Brand-inspired bolt-action handgun presented against a graphic red background

title: HECOR / High-Energy Concentration Orbital Weapon
summary: A speculative orbital weapon developed through modelling, poster design, motion, and fictional technical imagery.
description: Built around the SCP Foundation universe, HECOR is a fictional weapon described in SCP-7600. The long poster represents a scene from that entry. HECOR stands for High-Energy Concentration Orbital Railgun.
coverAlt: Tall technical poster for the fictional HECOR orbital weapon
quote: HECOR primarily operates by tracking and locking onto a specified target's coordinates while heating its thaumaturgically-ontokinetic engines, doing so through use of a ritualistic rotation cycle. Upload completion of said circulation, it uses an immense amount of EVE to power its irrilite (a thaumaturgy-conducting metal, entirely excavated from the Earth by the Fae Empire during its peak) rails which proceed to fire a beam of energy with enough power to rival ten atomic detonations. A single shot costs a fortune, of course, and lasts a mere 20 seconds, but it evaporates anything within a 2-kilometer radius of the designated target.

title: SCP-9001 Site Romero-5 Underground
summary: An underground environment study focused on scene building, architectural scale, and 3D lighting.
description: I recreated the underground chamber described in SCP-9001. This scene-building and lighting study uses repeated stone structures, patterned surfaces, fog, and a concentrated overhead opening to establish scale and an uncanny ceremonial atmosphere.
coverAlt: Dark domed underground chamber lit by a bright opening overhead
quote: The door fully opens to reveal a massive, domed chamber; a twenty-sided room walled with stone columns that curve upwards, forming the dome, and a weaving pattern of interlocked stone tiles adorns the interior surface of the vaulted ceiling. The pale white of the fog outside is visible through a small circle of glass at the very top.

title: Rotten Inside / Banner Series
summary: A four-part banner for the Backrooms novel series Rotten Inside, combining typographic hierarchy with 3D modeling and graphic design to create a narrative across the posters.
description: The series gives four entries in Rotten Inside a related visual identity while allowing each banner to carry its own atmosphere.
coverAlt: Graphic banner from the Rotten Inside Backrooms novel series

title: Level PT-1 / Selva de Concreto
summary: A Backrooms environment imagining Selva de Concreto through dense composition, warm haze, and monumental concrete forms.
description: This scene-assembly study focuses on lighting and composition. Third-party environment assets from TheMask Scenebuild Megapack were arranged and lit to shape the concrete-forest office, with a clear path through the frame and a strong sense of depth.
credit: Environment assets: TheMask Scenebuild Megapack. My contribution: scene assembly, lighting, and composition.
coverAlt: Level PT-1 Selva de Concreto title artwork

title: MO / Chibi Character Showcase
summary: A fan-made chibi character and 25-second showcase animation inspired by SFU VTuber Mo.
description: A focused personal study in translating a 2D mascot identity into a simple 3D character and a short presentation piece. I modelled the character in Blender, created a lightweight armature for posing and motion, then assembled the final graphic sequence and timing in After Effects.
credit: Fan-made study. The character identity belongs to SFU VTuber Mo; this was not an official commission.
coverAlt: Fan-made chibi character study of SFU VTuber Mo
